const reportIds = $('Build Actions SQL').first().json.reportIds || [];

// Return multiple items — each gets executed separately by Update Base Costs Postgres node
return [
  {
    json: {
      sql: `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS base_patterns (
  group_name TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  pattern TEXT NOT NULL,
  pattern_services INT,
  base_cost_median NUMERIC,
  base_cost_avg NUMERIC,
  base_cost_p25 NUMERIC,
  base_cost_p75 NUMERIC,
  sample_count INT,
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
)`,
      reportIds
    }
  },
  {
    json: {
      sql: `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS allowed_actions (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  group_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  action_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(group_name, action_type)
)`
    }
  },
  { json: { sql: `ALTER TABLE services ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS pattern TEXT` } },
  { json: { sql: `ALTER TABLE employee_stats ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS overrun_index NUMERIC DEFAULT 0` } },
  {
    json: {
      sql: `INSERT INTO base_patterns(group_name, pattern, pattern_services, base_cost_median, base_cost_avg, base_cost_p25, base_cost_p75, sample_count, updated_at)
WITH recent_reports AS (
  SELECT id FROM uploads ORDER BY report_week DESC LIMIT 12
),
svc_totals AS (
  SELECT group_name, service_id, SUM(price) AS total_price
  FROM actions
  WHERE report_id IN (SELECT id FROM recent_reports) AND group_name IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY group_name, service_id
),
svc_patterns AS (
  SELECT d.group_name, d.service_id,
    STRING_AGG(d.action_type, '|' ORDER BY d.action_type) AS pattern
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT group_name, service_id, action_type
    FROM actions
    WHERE report_id IN (SELECT id FROM recent_reports)
      AND group_name IS NOT NULL AND action_type IS NOT NULL
  ) d
  GROUP BY d.group_name, d.service_id
),
pattern_freq AS (
  SELECT group_name, pattern, COUNT(*) AS svc_count
  FROM svc_patterns
  GROUP BY group_name, pattern
),
top_patterns AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (group_name) group_name, pattern, svc_count
  FROM pattern_freq
  ORDER BY group_name, svc_count DESC
),
pattern_costs AS (
  SELECT sp.group_name, st.total_price
  FROM svc_patterns sp
  JOIN top_patterns tp ON tp.group_name = sp.group_name AND tp.pattern = sp.pattern
  JOIN svc_totals st ON st.group_name = sp.group_name AND st.service_id = sp.service_id
)
SELECT tp.group_name, tp.pattern, tp.svc_count,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pc.total_price),
  AVG(pc.total_price),
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pc.total_price),
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pc.total_price),
  COUNT(*),
  NOW()
FROM top_patterns tp
JOIN pattern_costs pc ON pc.group_name = tp.group_name
GROUP BY tp.group_name, tp.pattern, tp.svc_count
ON CONFLICT(group_name) DO UPDATE SET
  pattern=EXCLUDED.pattern, pattern_services=EXCLUDED.pattern_services,
  base_cost_median=EXCLUDED.base_cost_median, base_cost_avg=EXCLUDED.base_cost_avg,
  base_cost_p25=EXCLUDED.base_cost_p25, base_cost_p75=EXCLUDED.base_cost_p75,
  sample_count=EXCLUDED.sample_count, updated_at=EXCLUDED.updated_at`
    }
  }
];

const reportIds = $('Build Actions SQL').first().json.reportIds || [];
const idsArray = reportIds.length > 0 ? `ARRAY[${reportIds.join(',')}]` : 'ARRAY[]::int[]';

const sql = `INSERT INTO services(service_id, report_id, vendor, group_name, total_price, actions_count, employee_count, employees, action_types, pattern, base_cost, overrun, overrun_pct, zone, overrun_reason, extra_actions)
WITH svc_agg AS (
  SELECT service_id, report_id,
    MAX(vendor) AS vendor,
    MAX(group_name) AS group_name,
    SUM(price) AS total_price,
    COUNT(*) AS actions_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT employee) AS employee_count,
    ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT employee) FILTER (WHERE employee IS NOT NULL) AS employees,
    ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT action_type) FILTER (WHERE action_type IS NOT NULL) AS action_types
  FROM actions
  WHERE report_id = ANY(${idsArray})
  GROUP BY service_id, report_id
),
svc_patterns AS (
  SELECT d.service_id, d.report_id,
    STRING_AGG(d.action_type, '|' ORDER BY d.action_type) AS pattern
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT service_id, report_id, action_type
    FROM actions
    WHERE report_id = ANY(${idsArray}) AND action_type IS NOT NULL
  ) d
  GROUP BY d.service_id, d.report_id
),
computed AS (
  SELECT sa.service_id, sa.report_id, sa.vendor, sa.group_name,
    sa.total_price, sa.actions_count, sa.employee_count, sa.employees, sa.action_types,
    COALESCE(sp.pattern, '') AS pattern,
    COALESCE(bp.base_cost_median, 0) AS base_cost,
    GREATEST(sa.total_price - COALESCE(bp.base_cost_median, 0), 0) AS overrun,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(bp.base_cost_median, 0) > 0
      THEN ROUND((sa.total_price - bp.base_cost_median)::numeric / bp.base_cost_median * 100, 2)
      ELSE 0 END AS overrun_pct,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(bp.base_cost_median, 0) = 0 THEN 'normal'
      WHEN sa.total_price <= bp.base_cost_median THEN 'normal'
      WHEN (sa.total_price - bp.base_cost_median) / bp.base_cost_median <= 0.30 THEN 'small'
      WHEN (sa.total_price - bp.base_cost_median) / bp.base_cost_median <= 1.00 THEN 'elevated'
      ELSE 'critical'
    END AS zone,
    ARRAY(
      SELECT DISTINCT u FROM UNNEST(sa.action_types) AS u
      WHERE (bp.pattern IS NULL OR NOT (u = ANY(STRING_TO_ARRAY(COALESCE(bp.pattern, ''), '|'))))
        AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM allowed_actions aa
          WHERE aa.group_name = sa.group_name AND aa.action_type = u
        )
    ) AS extra_actions
  FROM svc_agg sa
  LEFT JOIN svc_patterns sp ON sp.service_id = sa.service_id AND sp.report_id = sa.report_id
  LEFT JOIN base_patterns bp ON bp.group_name = sa.group_name
)
SELECT service_id, report_id, vendor, group_name, total_price, actions_count, employee_count, employees, action_types, pattern, base_cost, overrun, overrun_pct, zone,
  CASE WHEN array_length(extra_actions, 1) > 0 THEN ARRAY_TO_STRING(extra_actions, ' + ') ELSE NULL END AS overrun_reason,
  extra_actions
FROM computed
ON CONFLICT(service_id, report_id) DO UPDATE SET
  total_price=EXCLUDED.total_price, actions_count=EXCLUDED.actions_count,
  employee_count=EXCLUDED.employee_count, employees=EXCLUDED.employees,
  action_types=EXCLUDED.action_types, pattern=EXCLUDED.pattern,
  base_cost=EXCLUDED.base_cost, overrun=EXCLUDED.overrun, overrun_pct=EXCLUDED.overrun_pct,
  zone=EXCLUDED.zone, overrun_reason=EXCLUDED.overrun_reason, extra_actions=EXCLUDED.extra_actions`;

return [{ json: { sql, reportIds } }];

const reportIds = $('Build Actions SQL').first().json.reportIds || [];
const idsArray = reportIds.length > 0 ? `ARRAY[${reportIds.join(',')}]` : 'ARRAY[]::int[]';

const sql = `INSERT INTO employee_stats(report_id, employee, department, services_count, total_earnings, avg_service_cost, non_standard_count, total_overrun, non_standard_pct, extra_action_count, overrun_index)
SELECT a.report_id, a.employee, MAX(a.department) AS department,
  COUNT(DISTINCT a.service_id) AS services_count,
  SUM(a.price) AS total_earnings,
  COALESCE(AVG(s.total_price), 0) AS avg_service_cost,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.zone <> 'normal' THEN a.service_id END) AS non_standard_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.overrun > 0 THEN s.overrun ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_overrun,
  ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.zone <> 'normal' THEN a.service_id END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT a.service_id), 0), 2) AS non_standard_pct,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN a.action_type IS NOT NULL AND s.extra_actions IS NOT NULL AND a.action_type = ANY(s.extra_actions) THEN 1 END) AS extra_action_count,
  ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.overrun > 0 THEN s.overrun ELSE 0 END), 0)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT a.service_id)::numeric, 0), 2) AS overrun_index
FROM actions a
LEFT JOIN services s ON s.service_id = a.service_id AND s.report_id = a.report_id
WHERE a.employee IS NOT NULL AND a.report_id = ANY(${idsArray})
GROUP BY a.report_id, a.employee
ON CONFLICT(report_id, employee) DO UPDATE SET
  department=EXCLUDED.department, services_count=EXCLUDED.services_count,
  total_earnings=EXCLUDED.total_earnings, avg_service_cost=EXCLUDED.avg_service_cost,
  non_standard_count=EXCLUDED.non_standard_count, total_overrun=EXCLUDED.total_overrun,
  non_standard_pct=EXCLUDED.non_standard_pct, extra_action_count=EXCLUDED.extra_action_count,
  overrun_index=EXCLUDED.overrun_index`;

return [{ json: { sql, reportIds } }];

const reportIds = $('Build Actions SQL').first().json.reportIds || [];

const sql = `WITH
  del AS (DELETE FROM anomalies),
  dept_avg AS (
    SELECT report_id, COALESCE(department, 'All') AS dept,
      AVG(avg_service_cost::numeric) AS avg_cost,
      AVG(CASE WHEN total_overrun > 0 THEN total_overrun::numeric END) AS avg_overrun
    FROM employee_stats
    GROUP BY report_id, COALESCE(department, 'All')
  ),
  action_counts AS (
    SELECT report_id, employee,
      MAX(department) AS department,
      COUNT(*)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT service_id), 0) AS avg_per_service
    FROM actions
    WHERE employee IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY report_id, employee
  ),
  dept_medians AS (
    SELECT report_id, COALESCE(department, 'All') AS dept,
      PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY avg_per_service) AS median_per_service
    FROM action_counts
    GROUP BY report_id, COALESCE(department, 'All')
  ),
  dup_agg AS (
    SELECT report_id, employee, service_id, action_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM actions
    WHERE action_type IS NOT NULL AND employee IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY report_id, employee, service_id, action_type
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
  ),
  gap_svcs AS (
    SELECT report_id, service_id, MAX(employee) AS employee,
      (MAX(action_date) - MIN(action_date)) AS day_span
    FROM actions
    WHERE action_date IS NOT NULL AND employee IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY report_id, service_id
    HAVING (MAX(action_date) - MIN(action_date)) > 1
  ),
  model_svc_counts AS (
    SELECT report_id, employee, group_name, COALESCE(subgroup,'') AS subgroup,
      service_id, COUNT(*) AS action_cnt
    FROM actions
    WHERE employee IS NOT NULL AND group_name IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY report_id, employee, group_name, COALESCE(subgroup,''), service_id
  ),
  model_medians AS (
    SELECT report_id, group_name, subgroup,
      PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY action_cnt) AS median_actions
    FROM model_svc_counts
    GROUP BY report_id, group_name, subgroup
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
  ),
  model_emp_avg AS (
    SELECT report_id, employee, group_name, subgroup,
      ROUND(AVG(action_cnt)::numeric, 2) AS avg_actions,
      COUNT(*) AS svc_count
    FROM model_svc_counts
    GROUP BY report_id, employee, group_name, subgroup
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
  )
INSERT INTO anomalies(report_id, anomaly_type, entity_id, message, severity, metric, value, avg_value, deviation_pct)

-- 1. Employee avg cost / overrun outliers (thresholds: 20% warning, 60% critical)
SELECT es.report_id, 'employee', es.employee,
  CASE
    WHEN da.avg_cost > 0 AND es.avg_service_cost > da.avg_cost * 1.2
    THEN 'Средняя стоимость выше средней по отделу на ' || ROUND((es.avg_service_cost::numeric / NULLIF(da.avg_cost::numeric, 0) - 1) * 100, 0) || '%'
    ELSE 'Перерасход выше среднего по отделу на ' || ROUND(CASE WHEN COALESCE(da.avg_overrun::numeric,0)>0 THEN (es.total_overrun::numeric/NULLIF(da.avg_overrun::numeric,0)-1)*100 ELSE 100 END, 0) || '%'
  END,
  CASE
    WHEN (da.avg_cost > 0 AND es.avg_service_cost > da.avg_cost * 1.6)
      OR (COALESCE(da.avg_overrun,0) > 0 AND es.total_overrun > da.avg_overrun * 1.6) THEN 'critical'
    ELSE 'warning' END,
  CASE WHEN da.avg_cost > 0 AND es.avg_service_cost > da.avg_cost * 1.2 THEN 'avg_service_cost' ELSE 'total_overrun' END,
  CASE WHEN da.avg_cost > 0 AND es.avg_service_cost > da.avg_cost * 1.2 THEN es.avg_service_cost::numeric ELSE es.total_overrun::numeric END,
  CASE WHEN da.avg_cost > 0 AND es.avg_service_cost > da.avg_cost * 1.2 THEN da.avg_cost::numeric ELSE COALESCE(da.avg_overrun::numeric,0) END,
  ROUND(CASE
    WHEN da.avg_cost > 0 AND es.avg_service_cost > da.avg_cost * 1.2
    THEN (es.avg_service_cost::numeric / NULLIF(da.avg_cost::numeric, 0) - 1) * 100
    ELSE CASE WHEN COALESCE(da.avg_overrun::numeric,0) > 0 THEN (es.total_overrun::numeric/NULLIF(da.avg_overrun::numeric,0)-1)*100 ELSE 100 END
  END, 2)
FROM employee_stats es
JOIN dept_avg da ON da.report_id = es.report_id AND da.dept = COALESCE(es.department, 'All')
WHERE (da.avg_cost > 0 AND es.avg_service_cost > da.avg_cost * 1.2)
  OR (COALESCE(da.avg_overrun,0) > 0 AND es.total_overrun > da.avg_overrun * 1.2)

UNION ALL

-- 2. Duplicate actions
SELECT report_id, 'duplicate_action', employee,
  'Обращение #' || service_id || ': «' || action_type || '» повторяется ' || cnt || '×',
  CASE WHEN cnt >= 3 THEN 'critical' ELSE 'warning' END,
  'repeat_count', cnt::numeric, 1::numeric, ((cnt - 1) * 100.0)::numeric
FROM dup_agg

UNION ALL

-- 3. Excess actions vs dept median
SELECT ac.report_id, 'excess_actions', ac.employee,
  'Среднее ' || ROUND(ac.avg_per_service::numeric, 1) || ' действий/обращение (медиана отдела: ' || ROUND(dm.median_per_service::numeric, 1) || ')',
  CASE WHEN ac.avg_per_service > dm.median_per_service * 2.0 THEN 'critical' ELSE 'warning' END,
  'avg_actions_per_service',
  ROUND(ac.avg_per_service::numeric, 2),
  ROUND(dm.median_per_service::numeric, 2),
  ROUND((ac.avg_per_service::numeric / NULLIF(dm.median_per_service::numeric, 0) - 1) * 100, 2)
FROM action_counts ac
JOIN dept_medians dm ON dm.report_id = ac.report_id AND dm.dept = COALESCE(ac.department, 'All')
JOIN employee_stats es ON es.report_id = ac.report_id AND es.employee = ac.employee
WHERE ac.avg_per_service > dm.median_per_service * 1.4
  AND ac.avg_per_service > 3
  AND es.services_count >= 3

UNION ALL

-- 4. Multi-day gap between actions on same service
SELECT gs.report_id, 'gap_anomaly', gs.employee,
  'Обращение #' || gs.service_id || ': разрыв ' || gs.day_span || ' дн. между действиями — рекомендуется проверить',
  CASE WHEN gs.day_span >= 7 THEN 'critical' ELSE 'warning' END,
  'day_span', gs.day_span::numeric, 1::numeric, ((gs.day_span - 1) * 100.0)::numeric
FROM gap_svcs gs

UNION ALL

-- 5. Excess actions vs model-level peers
SELECT me.report_id, 'model_excess', me.employee,
  me.group_name || CASE WHEN me.subgroup != '' THEN ' ' || me.subgroup ELSE '' END ||
  ': среднее ' || me.avg_actions || ' действий/обращение (медиана по модели: ' || ROUND(mm.median_actions::numeric, 1) || ')',
  CASE WHEN me.avg_actions > mm.median_actions * 2.0 THEN 'critical' ELSE 'warning' END,
  'model_avg_actions',
  me.avg_actions::numeric,
  ROUND(mm.median_actions::numeric, 2),
  ROUND((me.avg_actions::numeric / NULLIF(mm.median_actions::numeric, 0) - 1) * 100, 2)
FROM model_emp_avg me
JOIN model_medians mm ON mm.report_id = me.report_id
  AND mm.group_name = me.group_name AND mm.subgroup = me.subgroup
WHERE me.avg_actions > mm.median_actions * 1.4
  AND me.avg_actions > 3
`;

return [{ json: { sql, reportIds } }];

const reportIds = $('Build Actions SQL').first().json.reportIds || [];
const idsArray = reportIds.length > 0 ? `ARRAY[${reportIds.join(',')}]` : 'ARRAY[]::int[]';

const sql = `WITH del AS (DELETE FROM weekly_insights WHERE report_id = ANY(${idsArray}))
INSERT INTO weekly_insights(report_id, insight_type, message, change_pct, direction)
SELECT curr.report_id, t.insight_type, t.message, t.change_pct,
  CASE WHEN t.change_pct > 0 THEN 'up' ELSE 'down' END as direction
FROM v_weekly_summary curr
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT * FROM v_weekly_summary prev
  WHERE prev.report_week < curr.report_week
  ORDER BY prev.report_week DESC LIMIT 1
) prev ON TRUE
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
  ('services_count',
   'Обращений ' || CASE WHEN curr.total_services > prev.total_services THEN 'больше' ELSE 'меньше' END
   || ' на ' || ROUND(ABS((curr.total_services - prev.total_services) * 100.0 / NULLIF(prev.total_services, 0)), 1) || '% (' || prev.total_services || ' → ' || curr.total_services || ')',
   ROUND((curr.total_services - prev.total_services) * 100.0 / NULLIF(prev.total_services, 0), 2)::numeric),
  ('payments',
   'Выплаты ' || CASE WHEN curr.total_payments > prev.total_payments THEN 'выросли' ELSE 'снизились' END
   || ' на ' || ROUND(ABS((curr.total_payments::numeric - prev.total_payments::numeric) * 100.0 / NULLIF(prev.total_payments::numeric, 0)), 1) || '%',
   ROUND((curr.total_payments::numeric - prev.total_payments::numeric) * 100.0 / NULLIF(prev.total_payments::numeric, 0), 2)::numeric),
  ('overrun',
   'Перерасход ' || CASE WHEN curr.total_overrun > prev.total_overrun THEN 'вырос' ELSE 'снизился' END
   || ' на ' || ROUND(ABS((curr.total_overrun::numeric - prev.total_overrun::numeric) * 100.0 / NULLIF(prev.total_overrun::numeric, 0)), 1) || '%',
   ROUND((curr.total_overrun::numeric - prev.total_overrun::numeric) * 100.0 / NULLIF(prev.total_overrun::numeric, 0), 2)::numeric),
  ('avg_cost',
   'Средняя стоимость ' || CASE WHEN curr.avg_service_cost > prev.avg_service_cost THEN 'выросла' ELSE 'снизилась' END
   || ' на ' || ROUND(ABS((curr.avg_service_cost::numeric - prev.avg_service_cost::numeric) * 100.0 / NULLIF(prev.avg_service_cost::numeric, 0)), 1) || '%',
   ROUND((curr.avg_service_cost::numeric - prev.avg_service_cost::numeric) * 100.0 / NULLIF(prev.avg_service_cost::numeric, 0), 2)::numeric)
) t(insight_type, message, change_pct)
WHERE curr.report_id = ANY(${idsArray}) AND ABS(t.change_pct) >= 5`;

return [{ json: { sql, reportIds } }];

const reportIds = $('Build Actions SQL').first().json.reportIds || [];

const sql = `UPDATE services s
SET
  base_cost = COALESCE(bp.base_cost_median, 0),
  overrun = GREATEST(s.total_price - COALESCE(bp.base_cost_median, 0), 0),
  overrun_pct = CASE WHEN COALESCE(bp.base_cost_median, 0) > 0
    THEN ROUND((s.total_price - bp.base_cost_median)::numeric / bp.base_cost_median * 100, 2)
    ELSE 0 END,
  zone = CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(bp.base_cost_median, 0) = 0 THEN 'normal'
    WHEN s.total_price <= bp.base_cost_median THEN 'normal'
    WHEN (s.total_price - bp.base_cost_median) / bp.base_cost_median <= 0.30 THEN 'small'
    WHEN (s.total_price - bp.base_cost_median) / bp.base_cost_median <= 1.00 THEN 'elevated'
    ELSE 'critical'
  END,
  extra_actions = ARRAY(
    SELECT DISTINCT u FROM UNNEST(s.action_types) AS u
    WHERE (bp.pattern IS NULL OR NOT (u = ANY(STRING_TO_ARRAY(COALESCE(bp.pattern, ''), '|'))))
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM allowed_actions aa
        WHERE aa.group_name = s.group_name AND aa.action_type = u
      )
  ),
  overrun_reason = (
    SELECT NULLIF(STRING_AGG(u, ' + ' ORDER BY u), '')
    FROM UNNEST(ARRAY(
      SELECT DISTINCT u FROM UNNEST(s.action_types) AS u
      WHERE (bp.pattern IS NULL OR NOT (u = ANY(STRING_TO_ARRAY(COALESCE(bp.pattern, ''), '|'))))
        AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM allowed_actions aa
          WHERE aa.group_name = s.group_name AND aa.action_type = u
        )
    )) u
  )
FROM base_patterns bp
WHERE bp.group_name = s.group_name
RETURNING s.service_id`;

return [{ json: { sql, reportIds } }];

const reportIds = $('Build Actions SQL').first().json.reportIds || [];
if (!reportIds.length) {
  return [{ json: { sql: 'SELECT NULL as dtype, NULL as category, NULL as detail, 0 as total_price, 0 as base_cost, NULL as zone, 0 as overrun_pct, NULL as extra_actions WHERE FALSE', reportIds } }];
}
const idsArr = 'ARRAY[' + reportIds.join(',') + ']';

const sql = `
SELECT dtype, category, detail, total_price, base_cost, zone, overrun_pct, extra_actions FROM (
  SELECT
    'baseline' as dtype,
    s.vendor || ' / ' || s.group_name as category,
    array_to_string(s.action_types, ', ') as detail,
    s.total_price::numeric as total_price,
    s.base_cost::numeric as base_cost,
    'normal' as zone,
    0::numeric as overrun_pct,
    ''::text as extra_actions
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (vendor, group_name) *
    FROM services
    WHERE report_id = ANY(${idsArr}) AND zone = 'normal'
    ORDER BY vendor, group_name, total_price
  ) s
) baseline

UNION ALL

SELECT dtype, category, detail, total_price, base_cost, zone, overrun_pct, extra_actions FROM (
  SELECT
    'service' as dtype,
    s.vendor || ' / ' || s.group_name as category,
    array_to_string(s.action_types, ', ') as detail,
    s.total_price::numeric as total_price,
    s.base_cost::numeric as base_cost,
    s.zone,
    s.overrun_pct::numeric as overrun_pct,
    COALESCE(array_to_string(s.extra_actions, ', '), '')::text as extra_actions
  FROM services s
  WHERE s.report_id = ANY(${idsArr}) AND s.zone != 'normal'
  ORDER BY s.overrun DESC
  LIMIT 40
) sv

UNION ALL

SELECT dtype, category, detail, total_price, base_cost, zone, overrun_pct, extra_actions FROM (
  SELECT
    'anomaly' as dtype,
    an.anomaly_type || ': ' || an.entity_id as category,
    an.message as detail,
    COALESCE(an.value, 0)::numeric as total_price,
    COALESCE(an.avg_value, 0)::numeric as base_cost,
    an.severity as zone,
    COALESCE(an.deviation_pct, 0)::numeric as overrun_pct,
    ''::text as extra_actions
  FROM anomalies an
  WHERE an.report_id = ANY(${idsArr})
  ORDER BY an.severity DESC, an.deviation_pct DESC
  LIMIT 20
) anom
`;

return [{ json: { sql, reportIds } }];

options.instructions: Ты аналитик затрат сервисного центра. Отвечай строго в формате JSON без пояснений и форматирования.
